paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: Ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset. “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” refers to generative item scoring, and “ranking” refers to efficient candidate ranking.

annotations.annotation: The bar chart illustrates the metric Recall@10 for different methods or categories. The horizontal axis contains four categories labeled as "Ours", "critiquing", "scoring", and "ranking" with the categories listed in this specific order from left to right. The vertical axis represents the Recall@10 value, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 with intervals of 0.1. The bar for "Ours" is orange and reaches an approximate value of 0.35. The bars for "-critiquing," "-scoring," and "-ranking" are blue, with approximate values just below 0.3, 0.16, and around 0.23, respectively. The bar for "Ours" being the tallest is visually distinguished by its orange color, and "-scoring" has the lowest height, and except for "Ours", all other categories share a common blue hue. The bars are not sorted in ascending or descending order by value but are presented in the specified categorical sequence, with no additional visual emphasis such as bolding or outlining on any specific bar.
